budget: about 100 CPU-minutes at 2 threads: 24 G2 stack trainings (12 rebuilt, 12 fixed projection) and 72 Stage B trainings

checks: run_stage_b rebuilt R11's own Stage B group (R11B, seed 201; G0, G2, G3, and G2's misrouted control) identically to R11's record
the stack mechanics ran in R12C_DEV at a few training steps

label: DIAGNOSIS ONLY: P5 qualifies nothing and changes no R12 disposition. The Stage B condition reads the exact task coordinates (an oracle by construction) and is never a claimed inference path.
multiplicity: all P5 readings are diagnostic and uncorrected; none can qualify an arm
pairing: every comparison pairs the same (family, seed, episode): the P5 conditions run on the R12 records' own evaluation episodes
question: Does the last block's 120-parameter specialist receive the information its adaptation protocol needs (directive P5)? Is the failure explained by initialization, task-feature access, routing or a demonstrated absence of benefit (directive P8)?

rules.better: R12's frozen rule (preregistration.json rules.better): pooled geometric-mean ratio <= 0.95, one-sided exact sign test p < 0.05, and at least 2/3 of the 12 groups below 1; 144 paired episodes

attribution (P8).initialization: from study_r12.json: EXPLAINS_THE_T1_CURVE if G2's adaptation-curve criterion fails in T1 and holds in T2
attribution (P8).routing: the expert is fixed (one expert, weight 1), so routing cannot cause the failure; the identity readings say whether the trained specialist's identity matters

readings.benefit_ceiling (per regime): HEADROOM_UNDER_COORDINATE_ACCESS if Stage B G2 better than the regime's FFN-only stack in context (G0, k = 32); IN_CONTEXT_INFERENCE_BETTER if that G0 is better than Stage B G2; else INDETERMINATE
readings.identity (T2 stack; Stage B): IDENTITY_MATTERS if the correct specialist (or expert) better than the misrouted one; else NOT_ESTABLISHED
readings.integrity: every rebuild identical to its T2 record, the fixed projection unchanged, and every R12 integrity gate held in every stack evaluation; else NONQUAL_INTEGRITY
readings.projection (T2 stack): LEARNED_PROJECTION_BETTER if the rebuilt G2 better than the fixed-projection G2; FIXED_PROJECTION_BETTER if the reverse; else NO_DIFFERENCE_ESTABLISHED
readings.stage_b_assay (per regime): REPRODUCED if Stage B G2 better than Stage B G0 (R11 Stage B's specialization on these groups); else NOT_REPRODUCED
readings.task_feature_access (per regime; T2 attr: COORDINATE_ACCESS_BETTER if Stage B G2 better than the stack's G2 fast8; STACK_REPRESENTATION_BETTER if the reverse; else NO_DIFFERENCE_ESTABLISHED

stack.decodability: out-of-sample linear R² of the 4 task coordinates z from the specialist code q = P_in h (5 values) and from its input h = channel_norm(pre) (64 values); least squares with an intercept fitted on the fit episodes, scored per TEST episode; context-free probes and queries in context separately; for the rebuilt and the fixed-projection models
stack.fixed_projection: the same training with blocks.1.sparse.experts.0.cgc.proj_in.weight never learning (its initial value); nothing else changes
stack.measure: query MSE after 8 fast steps (fast['8']), with every R12 integrity gate per episode
stack.misrouted_branch: this family's rebuilt G2 with the other family's last-block specialist branch (proj_in, core, proj_out) substituted, then the standard 8-step evaluation
stack.misrouted_unit: this family's rebuilt G2 with the other family's whole last-block expert (FFN and specialist) substituted, then the standard 8-step evaluation
stack.rebuilt: fast_episodes.train_fast exactly as run_r12 episodic trains G2; verified against the T2 record: rows identical, selected step equal, the (step, dev_k32) trace equal

stage_b.access: u = Q_task x + Q_nuisance xi: the exact task coordinates through a fixed orthonormal embedding, with unit nuisance; no context
stage_b.measure: query MSE after 8 inner steps (row curve['8'][0])
stage_b.misrouted: G2 only: the other family's trained G2 expert on this family's episodes (R11's expert_misrouted control)
stage_b.procedure: run_r11.train_stage_b, then specialist_tasks.evaluate_arm, unchanged; every arm trains for both families before any evaluation; torch.manual_seed(0) first (R11's command_stage_b loop, restricted to the arms below)

stopping: no P5 record is rerun and no seed is added
no rule or measure changes after a P5 result
P5 changes no R12 record, rule or disposition
no new architecture: the oracle access is R11's Stage B harness, not a new path into the stack
a failed run is recorded as failed
